# Outbound — 20 Cold-Outreach Templates (5 personas × 4 channels)

20 templates total. Each persona file holds 4: **email, LinkedIn DM,
Discord/Slack DM, follow-up**. Every template has a personalization variable
block at the top — fill every `[bracket]` before sending.

| File | Persona | Templates |
|------|---------|-----------|
| `startup-founders.md` | Startup founders | 1A email · 1B LinkedIn · 1C Discord/Slack · 1D follow-up |
| `agency-owners.md` | Agency owners (white-label/overflow) | 2A email · 2B LinkedIn · 2C Discord/Slack · 2D follow-up |
| `ecommerce.md` | Ecommerce owners | 3A email · 3B LinkedIn · 3C Discord/Slack · 3D follow-up |
| `local-biz.md` | Local businesses | 4A email · 4B LinkedIn · 4C group DM · 4D follow-up |
| `creators.md` | Creators | 5A email · 5B LinkedIn/X DM · 5C Discord/Slack · 5D follow-up |

## How to use (per send, ~4 min)

1. Pick the persona file. Read the "find them" line.
2. Spend ~3 min researching: fill EVERY variable, especially
   `[SpecificObservation]` — one real thing you saw on their site/profile.
3. Send from YOUR accounts (C6 has no inboxes — see `../README.md`).
4. Log it: date, prospect, template ID (e.g. 3A), reply Y/N.

## Hard rules (no spam — these are load-bearing)

- Never send a template with unfilled `[brackets]` or a generic first two lines.
- ONE follow-up per prospect, 4–5 business days later (5–7 for local biz), then drop forever.
- Max 10 new prospects/day total across all channels. No automation, no sequences, no list-buying.
- Reddit/Discord/Slack DMs only where welcome and ideally after contributing. Never pitch in public threads.
- Only cite numbers you measured. No income, ranking, or conversion promises — ever.
- Every thread gets an easy out. "No" is a valid, final answer.
